headline: Council to consider wastewater plant funding, Tier 1A status application, and downtown marketing presentation.
summary: The council will hold a public forum, then act on a consent agenda covering contracts, resolutions, and license applications. Deliberative items include permit and license approvals, a Tier 1A status resolution, and a downtown event and marketing presentation.
items: Communication regarding petition (free the music free the art)
Extension of BED and Shelburne Limestone Agreement
Ecosystem Services Analysis funding request of $108,000 from Conservation Legacy Fund
Resolution: Authorization of Parking Revenue Financing for Department of Public Works
Resolution: Authorization for Capital Improvement Bonds for Fiscal Year 2027 and Public Improvement Infrastructure Bonds
Resolution: Authorization for up to $8,509,830 Step II Loan for Main Wastewater Plant Improvements (Stage 1)
Resolution: Northern Border Regional Commission Authorized Officials
Indoor Entertainment Permit Application for The Boardroom, 3 Mill Street
Tobacco License Application for What Ales You, 167 Main Street
Downtown Event and Marketing Presentation by BCA and CEDO
City Council general city affairs reports including Climate Emergency and Public Health & Safety updates
